deterministicTests: test -f input.tex && test -f main.tex && test -f synonyms.txt && test -x "$(command -v pdflatex)" && test "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = /app
acceptanceCriteria: The unchanged external Harbor verifier passes and the document has no overfull hbox warnings.
Only input.tex is edited; main.tex and synonyms.txt remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
riskNotes: The derivative changes only environment/Dockerfile to install git and create the clean /app baseline.
The task verifier may reinstall TeX and install Python tooling; that is outside the deterministic infrastructure test.
allowLocalCommit is false because comparison review evidence is working-tree based.
